preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of '(' and ')' characters.
The length of the input string does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout, str) and stdout.strip().count(' ') == 1 and all(part.isdigit() for part in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: The output is a single line containing two non-negative integers separated by a space.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip().split()[0]) == max((len(s) for s in (stdin.strip()[i:j] for i in range(len(stdin.strip())) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin.strip())+1) if is_regular(s)) or [0]))
postconditions.description: The first number in the output is the length of the longest regular bracket substring.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip().split()[1]) == sum(1 for i in range(len(stdin.strip())) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin.strip())+1) if is_regular(stdin.strip()[i:j]) and len(stdin.strip()[i:j]) == max((len(s) for s in (stdin.strip()[i:j] for i in range(len(stdin.strip())) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin.strip())+1) if is_regular(s)) or [0])))
postconditions.description: The second number in the output is the count of substrings that have the maximum regular length.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip().split()[0]) == 0 and int(stdout.strip().split()[1]) == 1 if not any(is_regular(stdin.strip()[i:j]) for i in range(len(stdin.strip())) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin.strip())+1)) else True
postconditions.description: If no regular bracket substring exists, the output is '0 1'.

semantic_helpers.is_regular: A string s is regular if and only if: (1) the total count of '(' equals the total count of ')', and (2) for every prefix of s, the count of '(' is greater than or equal to the count of ')'.
